caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing figure, shown in full length, mounted on a square plinth with beveled edges. The figure is rendered in earth-toned colors, primarily shades of brown for the skin and darker brown for the hair. The statue's attire includes a green knee-length skirt with a gold border and a red draped cloth over one shoulder, crossing diagonally over the chest and cinched at the waist. Gold bands adorn the upper arms, and the right ankle has a similar adornment. The statue's right arm is bent at the elbow and raised, while the left arm rests at the side. Around the neck hangs a necklace and what appears to be an animal head draped over the right shoulder. The head is adorned with a tall, colorful feathered headdress in green, yellow, and brown. The feet are bare, and one foot is positioned partially on a smaller block atop the main plinth. The background is a plain off-white color.
title: Cigar Store Indian
